purpose: Real-time cost and value tracking for all autonomous AI operations. Combines the FCC Cost Dashboard (Grafana UI), fcc-metrics-exporter (scrapes Free-Way usage), adaptive router telemetry, and economic guard to measure ROI and enforce spend caps.
services: grafana (PM2 online) — FCC Cost Dashboard, port=3001
model_policy: No AI needed for cost measurement
startup: Grafana and cost-dashboard auto-start via PM2; fcc-metrics-exporter on 5min cron
validation: PASS: Grafana responding with FCC Cost Dashboard title; economic_guard.py present; 27 telemetry lines
approval_gates: None — read-only telemetry; Nathan approval for spend limit changes
rollback: Restore fcc_metrics.json from backups; telemetry is append-only log
kpi: Daily spend vs $0.20 target / free_pct / premium escalation rate
